steps.title: Extract Total RNA
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA using the NucleoSpin RNA Plus Kit according to the manufacturer's protocol.

steps.title: Measure RNA Quality
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration and purity using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Reverse Transcribe RNA to cDNA
steps.instruction: Reverse transcribe 1 μg of RNA into cDNA using the High-Capacity cDNA Reverse Transcription Kit, following the manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the qPCR reaction mix per well in duplicate for each target and reference gene.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 μl SYBR Green qPCR Master Mix
Add 5 μl cDNA template (diluted 1:10 in nuclease-free water)

steps.title: Perform qPCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Perform amplification using a Light Cycler with specific thermal cycling conditions.

substeps.instruction: Run 50 cycles of: 95 °C for 10 s, 55 °C for 30 s, 95 °C for 1 min, 55 °C for 1 min

steps.title: Conduct Melting Curve Analysis
steps.instruction: Include a melting curve analysis from 55 °C to 95 °C.

steps.title: Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Record the mean Cq values for all reactions and normalize target gene expression (Atp13a4) to the reference gene (Gapdh) using the ΔΔCq method.
